sourceSnapshots.title: Create configuration files for data API builder
sourceSnapshots.shortSummary: Defines configuration responsibilities for $schema, data-source, runtime and entities, identity transmission through session context, environment-variable references and matching a schema to the installed DAB version.

sourceSnapshots.title: Define entities for REST and GraphQL
sourceSnapshots.shortSummary: Explains entity aliases, REST/GraphQL routes, field filtering, cursor pagination and relationship cardinality.

sourceSnapshots.title: Expose database objects, stored procedures, and views
sourceSnapshots.shortSummary: Describes explicitly keyed views, stored-procedure entities, procedure authorization or session-context controls for shared database connections, and one/many GraphQL relationships.

sourceSnapshots.title: Explore deployment options for data API builder
sourceSnapshots.shortSummary: Shows DAB container deployment, configuration packaging, runtime secret injection and distinct process-response versus data-access health probes.

sourceSnapshots.title: Recommend Azure monitor configurations
sourceSnapshots.shortSummary: Relates request, dependency and exception telemetry to API diagnosis; discusses correlated traces, container logs, latency/error indicators and alerting.

sourceSnapshots.title: Stored procedures in the REST API
sourceSnapshots.shortSummary: DAB stored-procedure REST uses execute permission, GET query parameters or POST JSON, defaults to POST, returns the first result set only, and supplies no parameter-level authorization.

sourceSnapshots.title: Data API builder configuration schema reference
sourceSnapshots.shortSummary: Current DAB schema reference separates data-source, runtime and entity settings and documents version-specific schemas, multiple configuration files and startup secret references.

sourceSnapshots.title: Deploy Data API builder to Azure Container Apps
sourceSnapshots.shortSummary: Packages dab-config.json in a custom image at the runtime path and supplies DATABASE_CONNECTION_STRING through deployment environment settings; requires a reachable supported database.

sourceSnapshots.title: Overview of Log Analytics in Azure Monitor
sourceSnapshots.shortSummary: Log Analytics queries Azure Monitor Logs; resource entry points scope records to that resource, while a workspace entry point supports workspace-wide investigation within granted permissions.

sourceSnapshots.title: What is change data capture (CDC)?
sourceSnapshots.shortSummary: SQL Server/Managed Instance CDC captures log-derived row values into retained relational change tables, with separate all/net-change functions and transaction metadata.

sourceSnapshots.title: What is change event streaming (preview)?
sourceSnapshots.shortSummary: CES remains Preview and streams DML CloudEvents to Event Hubs or Fabric Eventstream. Managed Instance requires SQL Server 2025 or Always-up-to-date policy; SQL Server 2025 Entra support starts with CU3 on Arc/Azure VM.
